hyperedges.label: Authentication Flow: Firebase + JWT + Role-Based Routing
Docker Infrastructure: DB + API + Frontend Services
Design System: Spec + Styleguide + Frontend Tokens

nodes.label: Retro-Brutalist 80s Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Interface is reverent, not costume: CRT phosphor glow on wet-concrete black, scanlines, monospaced terminals, VHS color. Building a machine for looking at photographs — restraint and signal density matter more than friendliness.

nodes.label: Color Token System
nodes.rationale: Dark mode is canonical; light mode is a secondary cooled-paper inversion triggered by data-theme=light and must never be the default. Phosphor green is primary accent used sparingly; amber marks digital zone; neon-red is danger/admin.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: All monospaced or geometric families (VT323, Share Tech Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Orbitron). No humanist sans, no serif except rare editorial pull-quote. Display and label type is uppercase.

nodes.label: Scanline Overlay Effect
nodes.rationale: Single body::after, fixed, full viewport, pointer-events:none. Mandatory on public home page; opt-in elsewhere via .scanlines class on wrapper. Only one node for entire app — do not duplicate per component.

nodes.label: CRT Power-On Boot Animation
nodes.rationale: One-shot on app load, never loops. Respects prefers-reduced-motion. Applied once to app root.

nodes.label: Top Navigation Bar Component
nodes.rationale: Fixed top, 48px height, surface bg, z-index 200. Tabs formatted as [PUBLIC] [ANALOG] [DIGITAL]. Active tab: phosphor text + 2px phosphor underline with glow-phosphor. Mobile collapses to hamburger drawer.

nodes.label: Photo Card Component
nodes.rationale: Masonry layout, border-radius:0, 1px grid border. Format badge top-right: 35mm=phosphor, DIGITAL=amber. Hover reveals caption overlay translateY with 200ms cubic-bezier ease.

nodes.label: Lightbox Photo Detail Component
nodes.rationale: Full viewport overlay, void bg, z-index 300. EXIF readout below photo as terminal line with //-delimiters. Keyboard nav with arrow keys and Escape.

nodes.label: Upload Drop Zone Component
nodes.rationale: 1px dashed phosphor border, min-height 240px. Terminal progress bar as text blocks. Button becomes TRANSMITTING... while uploading with blinking cursor. Debounced to prevent double-submit.

nodes.label: Status Bar Component
nodes.rationale: Fixed bottom, 28px height, z-index 100. Zone dot color: phosphor=analog, amber=digital, neon-red=admin, fog=public. Persists at all viewport sizes.

nodes.label: CSS Architecture
nodes.rationale: All colors/fonts/spacing/radii/durations/z-index as :root custom properties. Components reference tokens only — no raw hex inside component CSS. Tailwind for layout only; scoped component CSS for aesthetic effects.

nodes.label: Z-Index Scale
nodes.rationale: content:1, scanlines:50, status:100, nav:200, lightbox:300, modal:400

nodes.label: Design Prohibitions
nodes.rationale: No rounded corners >2px. No white/near-white backgrounds. No sans-serif body. No gradients. No friendly/warm UI patterns. No soft drop-shadows. No glow on body/EXIF text. No spinners. No emoji. Never make light mode default.

nodes.label: Technology Stack
nodes.rationale: Vue 3 + Vite + Vue Router + Pinia frontend; Node.js + Express.js backend; MySQL 8 database; Firebase Auth (Google OAuth); sharp for image processing; Nginx reverse proxy; Docker Compose. Images built on Apple Silicon must use --platform linux/amd64 for x86 deployment target.

nodes.label: Roles and Access Control
nodes.rationale: Three roles: admin, user, public. New users start as pending and require admin approval. Admin role can only be set directly in MySQL — no self-registration path to admin. Approved users get different permissions per zone.

nodes.label: Image Upload Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multer memoryStorage receives file buffer, exifr extracts EXIF, sharp resizes to max 2400px (quality 85) for full and max 400px (quality 80) for thumbnail. Both paths stored in photos table. Upload debouncing prevents double-POST.

nodes.label: Firebase Authentication
nodes.rationale: Google OAuth only via Firebase SDK on frontend. Frontend sends Firebase ID token to POST /api/auth/firebase; backend verifies with Firebase Admin SDK, creates/finds user, returns custom JWT with role. Frontend reads JWT role and routes: pending→/waiting, approved→full access, revoked→error+logout.

nodes.label: Google Photos Picker Integration
nodes.rationale: OAuth2 scope photoslibrary.readonly. Frontend authenticates via Google OAuth popup; selected photos fetched server-side using access token (backend proxies download to avoid CORS). Downloaded, sharp-resized, and stored like direct uploads.

nodes.label: Monthly Gallery Conflict Behaviour
nodes.rationale: Each calendar month has at most one gallery enforced by UNIQUE constraint on year_month. On 409 conflict, frontend silently redirects to existing gallery — no error shown. From user perspective it just works.

nodes.label: First Admin User Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: No self-registration path to admin. Must connect to MySQL and run UPDATE users SET role='admin', status='approved' WHERE email='...'; Alternatively INSERT with firebase_uid pre-emptively.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Production Deployment
nodes.rationale: Run ./deploy.sh which builds images targeting linux/amd64, runs docker compose down, then docker compose up -d. Host upload directory bind-mounted for persistence.

nodes.label: Missing Router Routes Gap
nodes.rationale: frontend/src/router/index.js missing /analog/:id/photo/:photoId route — photos not URL-addressable per README spec. Also PhotoUpload.vue has no registered route and is unreachable dead code.

nodes.label: Scanlines Not Activated Gap
nodes.rationale: body.scanlines::after defined in CSS but body never receives .scanlines class. However frontend/index.html does add class='scanlines' to body — the gap may be partially addressed.

nodes.label: API URL Mismatch Gap
nodes.rationale: README says PUT /api/admin/photos/reorder but route registered as PUT /api/admin/feed/reorder/bulk and store calls /admin/feed/reorder/bulk.
